product.title: MMOCoin Pay (USDC, USDT, MMO Subscriptions)
product.description: Accept instant Solana-based crypto payments & subscriptions in MMO, USDT, and USDC via pay.mmocoin.pro with automated usergroup upgrades and mandatory HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification.

phrasetype.name: Subscription
phrasetype.phrase: Enter your API key generated from the pay.mmocoin.pro merchant dashboard (starts with mmo_live_ or mmo_sk_).

Required. Must match the webhook secret set on this merchant's pay.mmocoin.pro account, with the webhook URL there pointed at this forum's payment_gateway.php?method=mmocoin_pay. Payments cannot be approved without it.
Base URL for MMOCoin Pay API (Default: https://pay.mmocoin.pro).
Comma-separated list of tokens to accept (USDC, USDT, MMO). Note: Ensure your payout wallet has at least ~0.01 SOL for rent.
If enabled, detailed checkout session creation and webhook verification logs will be written to mmocoin_pay_debug.log in the forum root.

phrasetype.name: GLOBAL
phrasetype.phrase: Pay securely using USDC, USDT, or MMO on Solana with instant automated subscription activation.
